subject.title: Export installed agents as grouped Claw packages

question: Should experimental `claws export` require complete, corroborated installed state in every default export, or should it also support an explicit degraded snapshot mode with a drift report and lineage metadata?
rationale: The branch’s public behavior sets a portability and recovery contract across lifecycle provenance, managed workspace state, package references, and follow-on cron ownership; choosing which incomplete states may serialize is a product and safety policy, not a mechanical review decision.

options.title: Require healthy exact state by default
options.body: Fail closed unless the installed agent, managed sidecars, recorded package identities/integrity, and applicable lifecycle ownership are complete and corroborated; add proof for rejection cases.

options.title: Add an explicit snapshot mode
options.body: Permit degraded export only behind a distinct mode that emits machine-readable drift, source lineage, and content-integrity metadata while leaving the default strict.

recommendation.title: Require healthy exact state by default
recommendation.body: Fail closed unless the installed agent, managed sidecars, recorded package identities/integrity, and applicable lifecycle ownership are complete and corroborated; add proof for rejection cases.
